Drugs.Name: Digoxin
Precautions: AV block greater than first degree or SA node dysfunction (without pacemaker)
Interactions with drugs having AV nodal-blocking properties

Drugs.Name: Amiodarone
Drugs.Subsequent Dose: Infusion at 1 mg/min (360 mg) over next 6 h, then 0.5 mg/min (540 mg) over remaining 18 h
Precautions: Sinus or AV conduction disease (without pacemaker)
Interactions with drugs having SA and/or AV nodal-blocking properties

Drugs.Name: Ibutilide
Drugs.Initial Dose: Contraindicated when QTc >440 ms; 1 mg over 10 min if ≥60 kg; if <60 kg, then 0.01 mg/kg
Drugs.Subsequent Dose: Can repeat 1 mg once, if arrhythmia does not terminate within 10 min
